slug: 2019-01-01 Identity and Electronic-Digital Government - Namibia (presentation, Melanie Tjijenda)

systems.tiers: not stated; the timeline dates its implementation to 2014 and the architecture slide gives it a civil registration and identity database of unique profiles

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Ministry of Home Affairs, as the slide's two lanes
systems.tiers: health side notifies, Home Affairs registers from the notification; about 73,000 notifications by June 2019

systems.owner: health, mortuary and Home Affairs, as the slide's three lanes
systems.tiers: health facility and mortuary notify, Home Affairs registers; about 8,000 notifications by June 2019
links eNPRS and eID to health, social protection, electoral and banking systems; framework implemented 2015/2016 under an agreement with eGA and Cybernetica of Estonia

note: Read from the artefact PDF. A 19-slide ID4Africa presentation of June 2019: it names eNPRS and draws its architecture but states nothing on which offices enter records, how the record is made, or who owns and funds the system.
